description: This Java source file defines the ConnectivityRootActor class, which manages supervision and orchestration of various actors in the connectivity system of the Eclipse Ditto framework. It sets up actors related to messaging, persistence, clustering, health checking, and more, forming the core supervisory component for connectivity features.

classes.name: ConnectivityRootActor
classes.description: Main actor responsible for supervising and orchestrating connectivity-related actors, including messaging, persistence, clustering, health checks, and HTTP server binding within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for ConnectivityRootActor with full configuration including command validator.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Overloaded factory method to create Props for ConnectivityRootActor without a command validator.

methods.name: getSupervisionDecider
methods.description: Defines supervision strategy, specifically handling JMSRuntimeException and NamingException by restarting actors.

methods.name: startClusterSingletonActor
methods.description: Starts a singleton actor in the cluster with specific role and name.

methods.name: getHealthCheckingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts the health checking actor with configuration set from provided connectivity configuration.

methods.name: getConciergeForwarder
methods.description: Creates and starts the concierge forwarder actor including enforcer router for cluster membership.

methods.name: getConnectionSupervisorProps
methods.description: Builds Props for the connection supervisor actor with provided configuration and optional command validator.

methods.name: getConnectionShardRegion
methods.description: Starts the shard region for connection supervisor actors with clustering settings.
